title: 1993 AMC 8 Problem 10
statement: This line graph represents the price of a trading card during the first \(6\) months of \(1993.\) The greatest monthly drop in price occurred during which month?

solutions.text:
The price changes month to month are: January \(\$2.50 \to \$2.00\) (drop \(\$0.50\)), February \(\$2.00 \to \$4.00\) (rise), March \(\$4.00 \to \$1.50\) (drop \(\$2.50\)), April \(\$1.50 \to \$4.50\) (rise), May \(\$4.50 \to \$3.00\) (drop \(\$1.50\)), and June \(\$3.00 \to \$1.00\) (drop \(\$2.00\)).

The largest drop is \(\$2.50,\) which occurred during March.

Thus, the correct answer is B .
hints: A drop happens where the line goes down from one month to the next; measure how far it falls each time
Compare only the downward segments and find the steepest one
